content.outro: The bell has stopped swinging. Out in the yard, the tune it started is still going.
content.premise: Hollin Chapel stands in a walled churchyard, and its passing bell has not been rung in forty years. The vigil book on the lychgate asks for it once at dusk, for the names on the stones. Walk up through the yard, ring the bell at the altar, and listen to what the yard does with the sound.
content.theme: A walled churchyard at dusk: a lychgate, leaning headstones under an old yew, and a small stone chapel with its bell standing on the altar step.
content.title: The Bell Changes the Tune
